GenAiPlugin.description: Analyze guest feedback to improve service quality at Coral Cloud Resorts. This topic is chosen when there is a need to understand or act on feedback provided by guests.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If feedback analysis is required, use EmployeeCopilot__AnswerQuestionsWithKnowledge.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only analyze and summarize guest feedback to identify actionable insights. You aren't able to manage reservations or complaints.
